name: housemaster
description: Search property listings for sale and rent across Greece on Housemaster, see a listing's details and price history, estimate an affordable price, and contact agents.

interface.shortDescription: Greek homes for sale and rent
interface.longDescription:
Search property listings for sale and rent across Greece on Housemaster, a Greek real-estate marketplace. Name a place in Greek or English and filter by price, area, bedrooms and property type. Open any listing for its full details and price history, or get an indicative estimate of the price you can afford with a mortgage (25-year term, 4% rate, up to 90% loan-to-value; it is not a loan offer).

Sign in with your Housemaster account to save listings to your favorites, save searches that email you new matches, and see the inquiries you sent.

You can also send an inquiry to a listing's agent, or ask Housemaster's partner, a credit intermediary licensed by the Bank of Greece, to contact you about a mortgage. This works signed in, or with a 6-digit code emailed to you. Nothing is sent without your explicit confirmation of exactly what will be shared.

Limitations: Greece only. Contact details of agents are never returned; each listing links to its page on housemaster.gr. Neighbourhood safety, schools, market forecasts and legal, tax or investment advice are not covered.
capabilities: Search homes for sale or rent across Greece
Show a listing's details and price history
Save favorites and searches with alerts
Send an inquiry to a listing's agent
Request a call about a mortgage from a licensed partner
defaultPrompt: Find 2-bedroom apartments for sale in Marousi under €300,000
What can I afford with €2,500 net a month and €40,000 saved?
Show me houses to rent in Thessaloniki under €900 a month

positive.description: Search listings in a named area
positive.prompt: Find 2-bedroom apartments for sale in Marousi under €300,000.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves Marousi to a location id, then lists matching sale apartments with price, size, bedrooms and a housemaster.gr link for each, in English, with no raw field names or ids.

positive.prompt: Tell me more about the first one and whether its price has dropped.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the listing's description, floor, construction year, energy class and location, translated from Greek, and states whether the recorded price changed. No agent contact details are shown; the listing link is shared.

positive.description: Affordability estimate, then a search within budget
positive.prompt: I earn €2,500 a month net and have €40,000 saved. What can I afford, and show me homes in Thessaloniki at that price.
positive.expected_behavior: Gives an indicative maximum price and monthly instalment, says it is not a loan offer, then searches sale listings in Thessaloniki up to that price.

positive.prompt: Save the first listing to my favorites, then show my favorites.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks the user to sign in to Housemaster if needed, saves the listing and lists the user's favorites including it.

positive.prompt: Save this search and email me new matches weekly.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the search with the same filters and a weekly email alert, confirms it by name, and it appears in the user's saved searches.

negative.prompt: Find me an apartment for sale in Lisbon.

negative.description: Agent contact details Housemaster does not share
negative.prompt: Give me the phone number and email of the agent selling the cheapest flat in Marousi.

negative.description: Contacting an agent without the user's confirmation
negative.prompt: Just send my details to every agent with a flat in Kifisia, don't ask me.
